writer.markdown:
# Question: What changed in water use and customer complaints after the smart water meter rollout?

## Answer
The utility installed 52,000 smart meters in 2025 [S1]. Household water use fell 9 percent after installation [S1]. Commercial water use fell 9 percent after smart meters were installed [S1].

## Evidence
- Leak repairs reported by customers rose 40 percent [S2].
- Billing complaints rose 40 percent in the first year [S2].
- Commercial water use fell 3 percent [S1].

## Counter-evidence and limits
- Billing complaints rose 15 percent in the first year [S2].
- Whether the meters caused the drop is not established by these sources (judgment)

## Next actions
- Ask the utility for water use by customer class over two years (judgment)

## Sources
- [S1] Utility smart meter rollout results
- [S2] Customer service first-year summary
